author: From STAFF REPORTS
title: Officials offer reminder of upcoming election dates - Weirton Daily Times
summary: Residents still wishing to register to vote, or change their party affiliation, have until Oct. 13 to do so. The election’s early voting period will run from Oct. 21 to Oct. 31, with those interested in taking part able to cast their vote by visiting the County Clerk’s Office in their respective county courthouse during regular business hours, as well as from 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Saturdays during that time. To receive an absentee ballot application, voters must call their County Clerk’s Office.
